why: C-TAM-TPB is a technology-acceptance and behavioral-intention model, not a general theory of learning or teaching, and this study-specific combination does not warrant a wiki page.
C-SATS is a named commercial surgical-video assessment platform rather than a general instructional element; its GEARS rubric is a component of that product.
name: C-SATS
product_description: C-SATS is a commercial platform that securely captures operating-room video and coordinates blinded reviewer assessment of surgical technical skill using the GEARS rubric.

why: C-Inquiry is a source-specific characterization and mapping framework for collaborative science-inquiry activities, not a general explanatory learning theory.
The C-Scale-I is a named, validated self-report measurement instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: C-Scale-I: a five-item Indonesian Confidence Scale for dengue-related prevention practice
product_description: A five-item Indonesian Likert-scale assessment developed by Hertanti Nuzul Sri and colleagues to measure primary healthcare nurses' perceived confidence in performing dengue-prevention practices.
